title: Company registers, sanctions search and reverse WHOIS (P231)
notes: Batch p2-G14-2 (pack only, no module). Order (P231 cond 6): company search (OpenSanctions, Companies House, OpenCorporates, GLEIF) first, then ViewDNS reverse WHOIS. Person-name and e-mail templates are privacy=true: rendered only for analyst-typed seeds of a case with a recorded purpose that opted in, never for discovered QSA partners, registrants, employees or customers (P231 cond 10, enforced by v3lum.core.links and the engine). Reverse-WHOIS results are ownership candidates for the analyst, never scope or own-asset evidence (P231 cond 11); ViewDNS reverseip and iphistory are not in this pack.

links.label: OpenSanctions - sanctions/PEP web search (manual; screening needs P222)
links.notes: Research C0539: free to browse per the FAQ; routine screening goes through the licensed P222 path.

links.label: OpenSanctions - sanctions/PEP web search for a person (case purpose required)
links.notes: privacy=true: analyst-typed person seeds of a case with a recorded purpose and the opt-in only.

links.label: OpenCorporates - company search (manual alternative to the paid API)
links.notes: Anti-bot 403 for scripts (C0527): unverified until checked in a browser (P231 cond 9).

links.label: GLEIF - LEI search (manual alternative to the API)
links.notes: Single-page app: the value travels in the fragment; route to confirm in a browser (P231 cond 9).

links.label: ViewDNS - reverse WHOIS (ownership candidates, not scope)
links.notes: Results are ownership candidates for the analyst, never scope or own-asset evidence (P231 cond 11). Research C0537 200 on 2026-11-25; Cloudflare managed challenge for curl on 2026-11-26: re-check in a browser.

links.label: ViewDNS - reverse WHOIS by person or e-mail (case purpose required)
links.notes: privacy=true (P231 cond 10): analyst-typed seeds of a case with a recorded purpose that opted in; never discovered QSA partners, registrants, employees or customers. Results are ownership candidates for the analyst, never scope or own-asset evidence.
